en: A postcard-style card with two main images on a cream background. On the left is a historical drawing of a stone castle with multiple round towers capped by red roofs, standing on a small island surrounded by water. The image is labeled with letters on the castle walls. On the right is an ornate Orthodox-style icon of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child, both with golden halos and framed in a richly decorated metal riza. At the top of the card are printed institutional and location details, and a reference number at the upper right.
